proposed_facts.reason: The explicit CHECK_GXBEGIN precedes the unconditional alpha-mode replacement; GXInit supplies GX_ALWAYS and threshold zero.
The packing sequence matches every stated field. __peReg has u16 elements, so the temporary's 0x41 high byte is discarded. No shadow-state or FIFO update occurs.
Canonical equality tests establish the mode mapping. SET_REG_FIELD preserves unrelated fields for valid inputs; the halfword destination excludes the temporary identifier byte.
GXInit configures ordinary blending earlier than poke blending and supplies NONE/ZERO/ONE/SET. Factors are written independently of the disabled blend enable.
GXPokeDither reads and writes a u16 register element using a u32 local, replacing bit 2. The valid-Boolean qualification correctly accounts for unmasked field insertion.
vNum is unsigned short, and both subsequent count tests use its narrowed value. Dirty bit 8 is only ORed in; display-list context saving uses val > 0 after its assertion.

contradictions.reason: Accept deferral of the .sbss fact and both section-attributed synchronization links. The four static declarations establish source objects, not compiled section membership, ordering or layout. Supported source-level synchronization knowledge remains retained.
Accept deferral of the attributed Flipper-workaround claim. The dispatcher establishes mechanisms but identifies neither an erratum nor supporting historical documentation.
Resolve the assertion-free alpha-mode description with proposal fact 0: CHECK_GXBEGIN is explicitly present and expands to an assertion.
Resolve both blend-register identifier claims with proposal facts 1 and 2. The identifier exists in the u32 temporary but cannot survive assignment through the u16 register pointer.
Resolve startup ordering and active-contribution claims with proposal fact 3. Ordinary defaults precede poke defaults, and GX_BM_NONE disables blending despite encoded zero/one factors.
Resolve the claimed 32-bit dither-register read with proposal fact 4: only the temporary is u32; the register interface is u16.
Resolve the raw-copy count description with proposal fact 5: narrowing precedes the zero tests, and a zero stored count does not clear an existing dirty bit.

unresolved: Compiled .sbss membership, ordering and layout remain unverified without compiled evidence.
The attributed GXSetMisc Flipper-workaround report remains an uncertain historical claim.
Malformed FAR decompression exponents 13–15 produce negative shift counts in canonical source; no portable or compiled result is asserted.

fact_dispositions.reason: Source proves four static zero-initialized objects and declaration order, not compiled .sbss membership or layout; no compiled artifact is supplied.

fact_dispositions.reason: Preserve attributed community hypothesis; canonical dispatcher cannot verify the unspecified Flipper erratum or comparison to unavailable documentation.
The claim of no guards omits the explicit GXBegin assertion.
Distinguish the u32 temporary's 0x41 high byte from the u16 register store; the high byte is not committed to PE register 1.
The register identifier is replaced only in the temporary, not the stored halfword; retain mode mapping and assertion with this distinction.
Zero/one factors are encoded with blending disabled, not proof of effective zero/full contributions. Normal rendering defaults precede poke defaults in the initializer.
The hardware-interface value is 16-bit, promoted into a u32 local, not a 32-bit register read.
Add meaningful narrowing detail: vNum is unsigned short and subsequent zero tests use the stored count, not the original u32 value.
